subskills.aim: Segment Addition Postulate, midpoint coordinates, and fractional partitioning of a directed line segment on the coordinate plane
subskills.archetype: Directed segment partition / algebraic midpoint

subskills.aim: Solve algebraic systems formed by supplementary, complementary, vertical, and linear-pair angles
subskills.archetype: Intersecting lines algebraic angle solve

subskills.aim: Apply alternate interior, corresponding, and consecutive interior angle theorems across parallel lines cut by single or double transversals (including auxiliary parallel lines through a crook angle)
subskills.archetype: Parallel lines & crook-angle transversal

subskills.aim: Translate a polygon on the coordinate plane using vector notation <a, b> or coordinate rule (x, y) -> (x + a, y + b), and recover pre-image coordinates from a translated image
subskills.archetype: Coordinate translation & pre-image recovery

subskills.aim: Reflect a polygon across x-axis, y-axis, y = x, y = -x, or horizontal/vertical lines x = h and y = k, and Rotate 90°, 180°, or 270° about the origin or an arbitrary center (h, k)
subskills.archetype: Off-origin reflection & rotation coordinates

subskills.aim: Determine compositions of rigid motions (glide reflections, double reflections over parallel or intersecting lines) and identify reflectional symmetry lines and rotational symmetry angles that carry a polygon onto itself
subskills.archetype: Composition of rigid transformations & symmetry mapping

subskills.aim: Apply Triangle Angle-Sum, Exterior Angle Theorem, and Isosceles Base Angles Theorem to solve for unknown interior and exterior angles
subskills.archetype: Exterior angle & isosceles triangle chain

subskills.aim: Distinguish valid triangle congruence criteria (SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS, HL) from invalid conditions (SSA, AAA) and determine the exact additional information required to prove two triangles congruent
subskills.archetype: Sufficient condition for triangle congruence

subskills.aim: Apply the Triangle Inequality Theorem, Hinge Theorem, and concurrency properties of circumcenter, incenter, centroid (2:1 median ratio), and orthocenter
subskills.archetype: Centroid 2:1 division & triangle side-angle inequalities

domains.domain: Similarity, Dilations, Thales' Theorem & Geometric Mean

subskills.aim: Perform coordinate dilations centered at the origin or an arbitrary point (x0, y0) with scale factor k, and apply the Side-Splitter (Thales) Theorem in nested triangles with a parallel transversal
subskills.archetype: Nested parallel transversal & off-origin dilation

subskills.aim: Solve bowtie/hourglass parallel-line similar triangles, indirect shadow/mirror measurement problems, and Triangle Angle Bisector Theorem proportions
subskills.archetype: Bowtie similarity, indirect measurement & angle bisector

subskills.aim: Apply the Right-Triangle Altitude Geometric Mean Theorems (h^2 = pq, a^2 = qc, b^2 = pc), reflected/inverted overlapping similar triangles, and k^2 area / k^3 volume scaling ratios
subskills.archetype: Right-triangle altitude geometric mean & area/volume k^2/k^3 scaling

domains.domain: Right Triangles, Pythagorean Theorem, Special Right Triangles & Trigonometry

subskills.aim: Apply the Pythagorean Theorem, its converse (classifying acute, right, obtuse triangles), and 45°-45°-90° / 30°-60°-90° special right triangle exact radical ratios
subskills.archetype: Special right triangle exact radical solve

subskills.aim: Use sine, cosine, and tangent ratios, complementary angle identity sin(theta) = cos(90° - theta), and inverse trigonometric functions to solve right triangles and angles of elevation/depression
subskills.archetype: Complementary trig identity & elevation/depression

subskills.aim: Apply the Law of Sines (including the ambiguous SSA case), Law of Cosines, and K = (1/2)ab sin(C) area formula to non-right triangles and navigation bearing problems
subskills.archetype: Law of Sines/Cosines & two-station sightline elevation

domains.domain: Circles: Arcs, Inscribed Angles, Tangents, Chords & Equations

subskills.aim: Calculate arc length, sector area, central angles, and inscribed angles (including Thales' semicircle 90° theorem and opposite angles of cyclic quadrilaterals)
subskills.archetype: Inscribed angle, cyclic quadrilateral & sector area

subskills.aim: Apply Power of a Point theorems for intersecting chords (PA * PB = PC * PD), secant-secant, and tangent-secant segments, plus tangent-radius perpendicularity
subskills.archetype: Power of a Point (chords, secants, tangents)

subskills.aim: Complete the square to convert general circle equations x^2 + y^2 + Dx + Ey + F = 0 to standard form (x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2 and find tangent line equations
subskills.archetype: Circle equation completing the square & tangent line

subskills.aim: Calculate interior and exterior angle sums of convex polygons and apply diagonal/side/angle properties of parallelograms, rectangles, rhombi, squares, kites, and trapezoids
subskills.archetype: Polygon angles & quadrilateral diagonal properties

subskills.aim: Compute surface area and volume of prisms, cylinders, pyramids, cones, and spheres, including Cavalieri's principle and 2D cross-sections of 3D solids
subskills.archetype: 3D volume, slant height & plane cross-sections

subskills.aim: Determine volumes of composite solids, frustums, solids of revolution generated by rotating a 2D polygon around an axis, and density/displacement modeling problems
subskills.archetype: Solid of revolution & composite volume displacement

subskills.aim: Interpret slope and y-intercept in context and solve linear equations and inequalities in one variable
subskills.archetype: Contextual linear rate & initial value

subskills.aim: Solve systems of two linear equations and determine the value of a parameter k for which a linear system has no solution, infinitely many solutions, or a unique solution
subskills.archetype: Parameterized linear system (no solution / infinite solutions)

subskills.aim: Solve linear systems of inequalities graphically and find maximum/minimum integer solutions in bounded feasible regions
subskills.archetype: System of inequalities feasible region extrema

subskills.aim: Factor quadratics, apply exponent/radical rules, and evaluate composite or transformed functions f(x - h) + k
subskills.archetype: Quadratic factoring, vertex form & function shift

subskills.aim: Apply Vieta's sum/product of roots (-b/a, c/a), discriminant analysis (b^2 - 4ac = 0 for tangency), and exponential growth/decay over fractional time periods t/k
subskills.archetype: Discriminant tangency, Vieta's roots & fractional-period exponential

subskills.aim: Solve nonlinear polynomial/rational/radical systems, identify extraneous roots, and match polynomial graphs to factored multiplicity forms
subskills.archetype: Line-parabola intersection & polynomial multiplicity

subskills.aim: Compute unit conversions, multi-step percentage increases/decreases, and conditional probabilities from two-way frequency tables
subskills.archetype: Chained percentage change & two-way table conditional probability

subskills.aim: Compare mean, median, standard deviation, and interquartile range (IQR) across two distributions or when an outlier is added/removed
subskills.archetype: Outlier impact on mean vs. median & standard deviation comparison

subskills.aim: Interpret statistical margin of error, study design (random sampling vs. random assignment for causal inference), and scatterplot residuals
subskills.archetype: Margin of error & causal inference study design

subskills.aim: Calculate area, perimeter, angle measures with parallel lines, and right-triangle trigonometric ratios
subskills.archetype: Parallel lines, right-triangle trig & area

subskills.aim: Apply complementary angle identity sin(x°) = cos(90° - x°), radian arc/sector proportions, and similar triangle ratios
subskills.archetype: Complementary trig identity & radian sector proportion

subskills.aim: Complete the square on circle equations to find radius/center/tangent endpoints and solve 3D volume scaling problems
subskills.archetype: Circle equation completing the square & 3D solid scaling
